text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa…… Roadwork completed! 
That concludes today's scheduled regimen, correct?
The long-awaited summer training camp. Fired up with vigor, Yaeno Muteki cleared today's training menu in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now then…… I shall proceed to recreation!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Reflecting on our time at the amusement park…… this camp, I shall purge all thoughts of training!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, there is something I must confirm……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
……No, pay no heed! 
Once I am certain, I shall report properly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now, this humble Yaeno Muteki shall frolic in the waves! Onward to the realm of empty mind……!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I have frolicked in the waves! Moving while evading the crashing tide sharpens spatial awareness for race positioning――……Wait, is this not training?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have enjoyed beach volleyball! 
Reading an opponent's form and explosive power is magnificent study for――Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……This is training as well, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Reversing my approach…… I went for another run, but……! 
Is this…… not just direct training?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
……Kuh, then as many attempts as it takes! 
Tonight I shall attend the summer festival! 
Trainer-dono, if your schedule permits, will you accompany me?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
……A formidable throng of people. 
Weaving through this density will hone my cornering maneuvers――No!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Kuh, even here I still think only of training……!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see! Target shooting has naught to do with racing……most likely! It may aid me in clearing my mind and attaining the state of selflessness!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My gratitude, Trainer-dono. Shopkeeper-dono! I request one challenge!
(Bang!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Mmh.
(Bang, bang!)

text_block_list.name: Elder Stallkeeper
text_block_list.text: Tough luck~! Missed 'em all, huh? Don't let it get ya down, try again!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To miss every shot…… I have displayed yet another shameful sight before you.
It was fine to fail, fine just to have fun. In play or in training, taking it a little easier was perfectly acceptable.
choice_data_list: I know you've been doing your best.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Fufu. Just as expected of you. At the amusement park, and now here……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I believe my heart is steeled at last. Trainer-dono, may I have a moment of your time?
I agreed, though I wondered what she meant. Little did I know, agreeing so casually would lead to――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Shopkeeper-dono! Five more challenges, if you please!
For a time, the sharp pops of cork guns echoed through the night――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh, how disgraceful! Still unable to hit a single mark! Truly laughable……!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Nay, next time for certain! I begin to grasp the knack. Like so, without excess tension……!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono, how does this look? Any flaw in my posture?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Much obliged! Steady the barrel. Steady……enjoy the moment, and……!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Advance!
(Bang!)
――With a soft thump, the stuffed cat Yaeno Muteki had targeted finally tumbled.

text_block_list.name: Elder Stallkeeper
text_block_list.text: Bullseye~! You got it, missy! Nicely done!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah……! Heartfelt thanks!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono, I did it! I have fully enjoyed this 'target shooting'!
On the way back from festival……Yaeno Muteki said she had something to discuss, leading us to training camp beach.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Just now, I felt as though I returned to my youth. Aiming a toy gun at another toy……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, deeply so!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……And thanks to that, my spirit is refreshed. Moreover, I finally understand why I could never cast off thoughts of training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is because I was ashamed of this raging fire within me outside the field of competition.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I believed letting this fiery nature flare during mere childhood play was unsightly and shameful――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thinking I must maintain rigid discipline, suppress my instincts, and devote every waking breath solely to training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yet you told me it was fine to be unsightly, fine to fail. That is why……I could let go of training and truly enjoy myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This fire is not something to fear. Nor is it……something to despise.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed――by your side, it is acceptable to set training aside.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer-dono. Will you join me in performing a 『Kata』 right now?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Somehow, I sense it will be unlike any I have performed before.
As festival drew to close and distant fireworks lit the sky, Yaeno Muteki assumed her stance for the 『Kata』.
Her movements carried a different essence than before. Like flames dancing in joyful play――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Haaah――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ――A wonderful respite, was it not?
……A performance both fierce and refreshing, perfectly suited for a summer night.
